business_service_specialization.label: Business-service specialization
business_service_specialization.value: Global online marketplace for unique and creative goods, including handcrafted, custom, and vintage items.

service_operating_model.label: Service operating model
service_operating_model.value: Two-sided marketplace connecting creative entrepreneurs with buyers and providing tools to start, manage, and grow their shops.

charging_unit.label: Charging unit
charging_unit.value: Per listing, per sale, and per payment processed. Advertising charges per click or attributed sale. Etsy Plus charges monthly.

customer_contract_term.label: Customer contract term
customer_contract_term.value: Pay-as-you-go marketplace selling with no fixed term and an optional monthly Etsy Plus subscription.

contracted_repeat_revenue.label: Contracted / repeat revenue
contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Repeat usage-based listing, transaction, payment processing, and advertising fees, plus optional Etsy Plus subscriptions.

software_deployment_737_software_service.label: Software deployment [737 software/services]
software_deployment_737_software_service.value: Etsy operates the online marketplace and provides buyer search and seller tools through the platform.

software_functional_scope_737.label: Software functional scope [737]
software_functional_scope_737.value: Product search and discovery, tools for managing seller shops, and technology for buyer-seller exchanges.

processing_transaction_platform_7374.label: Processing / transaction platform [7374]
processing_transaction_platform_7374.value: Online marketplace platform that facilitates sales between independent sellers and buyers.

advertising_agency_economics_731.label: Advertising / agency economics [731]
advertising_agency_economics_731.value: Etsy Ads charge sellers per click. Offsite Ads charge sellers per attributed sale.
